description:
OEDRO Cargo Mats Fits for 2010-2017 Chevrolet Equinox/GMC Terrain. The mats are non-toxic, odorless, contain no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVCs.
Features
Durability. One of the best things about the OEDRO cargo liner is that they are developed with strong rubber. This gives them longevity in comparison to other styles of mats. OEDRO floor mats are quite flexible. The heavy-duty material is also capable of withstanding constant rubbing and contacting of shoes.
Excellent Visual Appearance. By adding an all-weather cargo liner to your car’s interior, you will add color and class to your car. The mat’s unique appearance will accentuate the interior look of your car tenfold.
Protecting the Interior. OEDRO cargo mats offer vehicles perhaps the most comprehensive interior protection in comparison to any other car mat. Your car’s carpet will remain clean and dry at all times.
Cleaning these Mats is Quite Easy. The materials used for creating truck cargo mats are extremely simple to wash and clean. You can easily wash and clean the spillage on top of it. You can also spray it using soap and water. Also, there won’t be any odor remaining once the mat dries out.
It Traps Dirt and Moisture. The waterproof surface of all-weather cargo floor mats makes sure to trap any kind of spillage on top of it. The mats can also trap dust, sand, and other dry particles effectively.
2-Year Warranty | Professional installation recommended for safety.
Fitment
Fits for 2010-2017 Chevrolet Equinox.
Fits for 2010-2017 GMC Terrain.
Designed to protect the cargo area behind the 2nd-row seats
